Sandbox_TheRoadSoFarFM_DisableZombieAttr: When enabled, The Road So Far FM radios and cassette players do not emit world sounds that attract zombies. When disabled, louder device volume attracts zombies from farther away.
Sandbox_TheRoadSoFarFM_VolumePercent_too: Overall volume of The Road So Far FM music, for radios and cassette players, as a percentage of the normal volume. The volume slider of each device still works on top of this. 100 leaves the volume unchanged.
